tools.name: list_saved_words
tools.description: The words the person saved in Shangri Lingua for one language, newest first, each with its reading, meaning, the sentence it was saved from, and the day it was saved.

tools.name: save_word
tools.description: Saves a word to the person's Shangri Lingua saved words for one language, with its reading and meaning, so it joins their practice in the app. A word already saved is left as it is.

tools.name: words_due_for_practice
tools.description: The person's saved words that are due for review now in one language, most overdue first, then a few saved words never practised yet. Each has its reading, meaning and how far along the review schedule it is.

tools.name: record_practice_result
tools.description: Records that the person got one of their saved words right or wrong, which moves it along Shangri Lingua's review schedule: right and it comes back later, wrong and it comes back soon.

tools.name: list_my_mistakes
tools.description: The mistakes Shangri Lingua's proofreader found in messages the person wrote in one language, newest first: what they wrote, the correction, the kind of mistake and why.

tools.name: list_my_lessons
tools.description: The lessons Shangri Lingua wrote for the person in one language from their own words and mistakes, newest first: each one's title, what it teaches, and its id. With an id, that one lesson in full: its dialogue, its grammar point with examples, and its exercises.
